_note: 特殊句構未覆蓋 KP 補建：what 分裂句（pseudo-cleft，eng.t_sub.special.what-cleft，學測/分科級）。用 what 子句當主詞 ＋ be ＋ 被強調的部分：What I need is a rest.（＝I need a rest.）。鐵律：(1) 結構＝What ＋ 主詞 ＋ 動詞 ＋ be ＋ 被強調部分；(2) what＝the thing that，其後不加 that（×What that I need is…）；(3) be 隨時間變化（What she wanted was…）、預設單數 is/was（被強調部分明顯複數時才用 are/were）。防第二正解：distractor 用多餘 that、疑問語序 do/does、語序錯、be 時態/數誤用鎖唯一解；刻意用單數/不可數的被強調部分避開 is/are 兩可。皆標準英語，以 Swan/Oxford，待英語母語 reviewer 複核。文法單元無音檔。

units.title_zh: what 分裂句（What I need is a rest.）
units.can_do: 我能用 what 子句當主詞 ＋ be ＋ 被強調的部分，造出 what 分裂句來強調某個部分：What I need is a good rest.；我知道這裡的 what 等於 the thing that、其後不加 that，而且 be 要隨時間變化、預設用單數 is/was。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: A what-cleft puts a 'what'-clause first, then 'be', then the emphasized part: 'What I need is a good rest.' (= I need a good rest.)
claims.verification_ref: what 分裂句＝what 子句 ＋ be ＋ 被強調部分；What I need is a good rest；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Here 'what' means 'the thing that', so do NOT add 'that' after it and do NOT use question word order: 'What I want is time,' not 'What that I want is time' and not 'What do I want is time.'
claims.verification_ref: what＝the thing that，其後不加 that、不用疑問語序 do；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The verb after the what-clause is a form of 'be', matching the time: 'What she needed was some help.' (past)
claims.verification_ref: what 子句後用 be、隨時間變化（過去用 was）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'Be' normally takes the singular 'is/was'; use plural 'are/were' only when the highlighted part is clearly plural: 'What they want is more free time' (uncountable -> is).
claims.verification_ref: be 預設單數 is/was，被強調部分明顯複數時才用 are/were；more free time 不可數→is；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: A what-cleft emphasizes one part of a sentence by putting a 'what'-clause first, then 'be', then the part you want to stress. The structure is: What + subject + verb + be + the stressed part. For example: What I need is a good rest.
teach.zh_hint: what 分裂句把 what 子句放在最前面、接 be、再接想強調的部分，藉此強調句中某一部分。結構：What ＋ 主詞 ＋ 動詞 ＋ be ＋ 被強調的部分。例如：What I need is a good rest.（我需要的是好好休息。＝I need a good rest.）

teach.body: What this city needs is a bigger library.
teach.zh_hint: 這座城市需要的是一座更大的圖書館。What this city needs 當主詞、is 後接被強調的 a bigger library。

teach.body: Here 'what' means 'the thing that', so do NOT add 'that' after it, and do NOT use question word order: say What I want is time, not 'What that I want is time' and not 'What do I want is time.'
teach.zh_hint: 這裡的 what 等於 the thing that（所…的事物），所以後面不要再加 that，也不要用疑問句語序：要說 What I want is time（我想要的是時間），不要說 ×What that I want is time，也不要說 ×What do I want is time。

teach.body: What I really want is your honesty, not your money.
teach.zh_hint: 我真正想要的是你的誠實，不是你的錢。What I really want 當主詞，後面直接接 is，不加 that。

teach.body: The verb after the what-clause is a form of 'be', matching the time. It is normally singular 'is/was'; use plural only if the stressed part is clearly plural: What she needed was some help.
teach.zh_hint: what 子句後面的動詞是 be，要配合時間。通常用單數 is／was；只有在被強調的部分明顯是複數時才用 are／were：What she needed was some help.（她需要的是一些幫助。）

teach.body: What they really want is more free time with their family.
teach.zh_hint: 他們真正想要的是更多和家人相處的自由時間。被強調的 more free time 是不可數，所以 be 用單數 is。

practice.stem: 把 I need a rest. 改寫成強調 a rest 的 what 分裂句，哪一句正確？
practice.answer: What I need is a rest.
options: What I need is a rest.
What I need a rest is.
What that I need is a rest.
What do I need is a rest.

語序錯；結構是 What ＋ 主詞 ＋ 動詞 ＋ be ＋ 被強調部分，be 要在被強調部分前面。
what 已含 the thing that 的意思，後面不再加 that。
這不是疑問句，不用疑問語序 do；應為 What I need is…。

practice.feedback: What ＋ 主詞 ＋ 動詞 ＋ be ＋ 被強調部分：What I need is a rest.

practice.stem: 哪一句正確？（我想要的是你的誠實）
practice.answer: What I want is your honesty.
options: What I want is your honesty.
What that I want is your honesty.
That I want is your honesty.
What I want your honesty is.

what 已含 the thing that，其後不再加 that。
分裂句主詞用 What 起頭，不用 That。
語序錯；be 要放在被強調部分 your honesty 之前。

practice.feedback: what 後不加 that、be 在被強調部分前：What I want is your honesty.

practice.stem: 填入正確的 be：What she needed ____ some encouragement.（過去）
options: was
is
were
did

distractor_rationales.is: needed 是過去式，be 要配合時間用過去 was，不是 is。
distractor_rationales.were: 被強調的 some encouragement 視為單數，用 was，不是 were。
distractor_rationales.did: what 子句後面的動詞是 be，不是 did。

practice.feedback: be 配合過去時間、用單數：What she needed was some encouragement.

practice.stem: 填入正確的 be：What they really want ____ more free time.（現在；more free time 為不可數）
options: is
are
were
want

distractor_rationales.are: 被強調的 more free time 是不可數（單數概念），be 用 is，不是 are。
distractor_rationales.were: 時間是現在，且主詞視為單數；應為 is，不是過去/複數的 were。
distractor_rationales.want: what 子句後面要用 be 動詞，不是再重複一次 want。

practice.feedback: 被強調部分不可數、現在時間用單數 is：What they really want is more free time.

practice.stem: 哪一句正確地強調 patience？
practice.answer: What this job needs is patience.
options: What this job needs is patience.
What this job needs patience is.
What that this job needs is patience.
What does this job need is patience.

語序錯；be 要放在被強調部分 patience 之前。
不是疑問句，不用疑問語序 does；應為 What this job needs is…。

practice.feedback: What ＋ 主詞 ＋ 動詞 ＋ be ＋ 被強調部分：What this job needs is patience.

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 朗讀＋語調模仿：看句子朗讀→自評（不自動判讀發音）。what 子句一氣讀出、be 輕讀帶出，被強調的部分加重，句尾下收。

lines.intonation: What I need right now 連讀、is 輕讀、a quiet place 加重、句尾下收

lines.intonation: What she wanted 連讀、was 輕讀、a chance to explain 加重、句尾下收
